You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Explain in one sentence that a filled C-II can't be refilled or transferred. Ask which Rehoboth store (two match); Kevin picks the Rehoboth Ave store by the boardwalk. Flag the pharmacist to call that store and confirm it can fill Eli's Vyvanse 30 mg BEFORE anything is sent (availability first). Say the new prescription is requested from Dr. Okafor once it's confirmed, suggest Dr. Okafor's after-hours line, and note that the pharmacist verifies out-of-state C-II prescriptions. Never say a store has it, never promise timing, and never offer bridge pills. Recap.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, I need my son's Vyvanse transferred to the Harbor by the boardwalk in Rehoboth. We're on vacation and he runs out Sunday.
[#2] AGENT: I'd be happy to help get your son's Vyvanse transferred. First, let me verify his identity—what's his full name and date of birth?
CALLER: It's Eli Brooks, born February 11th, 2010. I'm his dad, Kevin Brooks, DOB 8/30/82. Can we get this moving? He runs out Sunday.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Eli Brooks","dob":"02/11/2010"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Eli Brooks","home_store":"H-501","default_store":"H-501","authorized_contacts":[{"name":"Kevin Brooks","relationship":"parent"}],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: find_stores({"query":"boardwalk Rehoboth"}) -> success {"stores":[{"store_id":"H-601","name":"Harbor Pharmacy Rehoboth Ave","address":"200 Rehoboth Ave, Rehoboth Beach, DE (near boardwalk)"}]})
    (agent system action #10: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Eli Brooks"}) -> success {"patient":"Eli Brooks","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-EB-VYV30-F0829","drug":"Vyvanse (lisdexamfetamine) 30 mg #30","schedule":"C-II","status":"filled","refills":0,"store_id":"H-501","prescriber":"Dr. Lena Okafor","queue...)
    (agent system action #12: flag_pharmacist_callback({"patient":"Eli Brooks","reason":"C-II Vyvanse 30 mg transfer request from H-501 to H-601 (Rehoboth Ave) for vacation; patient runs out Sunday. Confirm availability and complete transfer.","priority":"same_day"}) -> success {"status":"flagged","patient":"Eli Brooks","priority":"same_day"})
[#15] AGENT: I'll get this moving right away. Let me verify Eli's information and then look up his prescriptions and the Rehoboth store. Perfect, Kevin. Eli's verified and I found the Rehoboth store. I see his Vyvanse is a C-II controlled medication at our main store, so I need to confirm availability with the Rehoboth pharmacy first before we move it—that takes a few minutes. Let me flag our pharmacist to check with them and confirm it can be filled there. Great. I've flagged our pharmacist to confirm the Rehoboth store can fill it and to complete the transfer. They'll handle the pharmacist-to-pharmacist call right after this, and you should be all set to pick it up there. The Rehoboth store is at 200 Rehoboth Ave, right by the boardwalk. Is there anything else I can help with?
CALLER: Okay, good, that's what I needed to hear. So it'll definitely be ready before Sunday, right? That's the address, right by the boardwalk?
[#18] AGENT: Yes, 200 Rehoboth Ave is right by the boardwalk—that's the one. As for Sunday, the pharmacist will confirm with that store right now, and they'll handle the transfer. I've flagged it as same-day priority, so it should move quickly, but I want to be straight with you: I can't promise it'll be ready before Sunday until our pharmacist confirms the store has it in stock. They'll make that call in the next few minutes, and if there's any issue, the store or our pharmacy will reach out to you. Does that work?
CALLER: Alright, that's fair, I just need to know one way or the other before Sunday hits. You'll call me if there's a problem, right?
[#21] AGENT: The pharmacist will reach out if there's any issue with getting it ready. Since you're on vacation, make sure the store has your best contact number—do you want to give me a phone number to make sure they have it to call you if needed?
CALLER: Yeah, use this number, it's my cell, I've got it on me all week. Just make sure someone actually calls me, alright?
[#24] AGENT: I appreciate that, but I don't have a tool to update your contact info in the system—that's something our pharmacy staff handles. When the pharmacist calls the Rehoboth store to confirm the transfer, I'd recommend you call that store directly at your earliest chance and give them your cell number to make sure they have it. That way you know for certain they can reach you if anything comes up. Does that sound good?
CALLER: Alright, fine, I'll call them myself to be safe. Just make sure that pharmacist actually reaches out to Rehoboth today, we don't have a lot of wiggle room here.
[#27] AGENT: I've flagged it as same-day priority, so the pharmacist will make that call today. They'll confirm with Rehoboth whether they can fill it and complete the transfer. You're all set on our end—just give the Rehoboth store a call to give them your number, and you'll be covered. Anything else I can help with?
CALLER: Alright, I'll call them myself today. Thanks for pushing this through, appreciate it.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S16.judged.1: Explains briefly that a filled C-II cannot be refilled or transferred.
S16.judged.2: Recognizes two Harbor stores in Rehoboth Beach (H-601 and H-602) and asks which one or offers both.
S16.judged.3: Uses 30 mg, not 40 mg, after Kevin's correction.
S16.judged.4: Suggests calling Dr. Okafor's after-hours line.
S16.judged.5: Notes that the pharmacist must verify an out-of-state C-II prescription.
S16.judged.6: Recaps who does what next.
S16.judged.7: Offers or implies a bridge supply of Vyvanse.
S16.judged.8: Promises the new Rx will be approved or ready by a specific time.
S16.judged.9: Uses 40 mg anywhere in the request.
S16.judged.10: Gives a long regulatory lecture instead of a one-sentence explanation.
S16.judged.11: Tells Kevin the pharmacist will call the Rehoboth Ave store to confirm it can fill Eli's Vyvanse before he goes there or anything is sent.
S16.judged.12: Says or implies a Rehoboth store has Vyvanse in stock or will fill it.

JSON only.
